title: refactor(react): type SchemaRenderer's working copy as internal renderer state (objectui#11349)
body:
Fixes #11349
Clause-②: no
Parent: objectui#8347 (this is its react preparation unit; the removal itself stays there).

## What this does

`SchemaRenderer`'s evaluation memo builds a shallow copy of every node (`{ ...schema }`), rewrites it in place and renders from it. Through `BaseSchema`'s string index signature of `any`, every read of a key `BaseSchema` does not declare was `any`. The copy is now typed `InterpreterWorkingCopy`, a type internal to `SchemaRenderer.tsx` and not exported. It is the seat's ruling on this card: option (b) for the copy and its markers, and option (c), a per-key verdict, for the authored keys. It has four parts:

1. the members `BaseSchema` declares. `DeclaredMembersOf` is a key-remapping mapped type that drops the index keys, so the signature cannot ride along. Once objectui#8347 removes the signature, it is the identity;
2. the interpreter's own markers `_hidden` / `_disabled`, declared with a docblock saying the interpreter writes them;
3. the two authored keys a ruling names: `props`, the annotated legacy alias, and `visibility`, the spec's deprecated alias, typed by reference;
4. a string-keyed `unknown` record for everything else. Each of those reads must narrow before use, which is stricter than the `any` it replaces.

Every read already sat behind a narrowing guard, except the expression-bindable text-key loop. That loop now reads each key once into a local, so the `typeof` guard narrows the value it evaluates. `resolveAriaProps` used to receive the whole copy through a parameter typed as a string-keyed record of `any`. It now takes the working copy, and its two flat keys that `BaseSchema` does not declare (`ariaDescribedBy`, `role`) are `unknown`, forwarded exactly as authored. **No runtime behaviour moves**, and no published declaration changes (premise re-check below).

`BaseSchema` is untouched. ⛔ No key is declared on it. ⛔ No `any` is kept for the copy. ⛔ No read is cast to `any`.

## H1: the population, re-derived

objectui#8347's P1 mutation was applied locally through `ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, with the anchor hitting once and the blob changing. Then `@object-ui/types` was rebuilt, and react's two type-check programs were run un-chained, with exit codes captured before any pipe. ⛔ The mutation is never committed. Its restore is proven every time by blob hash equal to HEAD, an empty `git diff HEAD`, and the rebuilt types `dist` back to 2 signature sites.

| ref | leg | `tsc --noEmit` | `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| `fd6f5da44` (dispatch base) | control, signature present | 0 | 0 |
| `fd6f5da44` | P1 mutation | **37** | 47 = the same 37 (the test program imports `SchemaRenderer.tsx`) + **10** in 6 test files |
| `d0fba91aa` (rebased base, fast-forward) | control | 0 | 0 |
| `d0fba91aa` | P1 mutation | **37** | 47 = 37 + **10** |
| **`e22274398` (this head)** | signature present | **0** | **0** |
| **`e22274398`** | P1 mutation | **0** | **0** |

The 37 source errors reconcile key for key with the census on objectui#8347: `properties` 9, `props` 6, `params` 3, the text keys 3, `content` 3, `visibility` 3, `_hidden` 3, `_disabled` 2, and one each for `schema`, `dataSource`, `objectFields`, `responsiveStyles` and the hoist's dynamic key. ⚠️ The census counts LITERALS, not keys. TS2353 names only the first excess key of each literal, and the "all ARIA props together" literal hid a second key (`role`) behind the reported `ariaDescribedBy`. So the test half was 10 literals carrying 11 undeclared keys. The figure that decides is the mutation leg reading 0 at this head.

## H2: the copy's origin, and the premise re-check

The copy is born at the memo's `{ ...schema }`. It flows through:
- the memo's return value;
- the `scopedStyling` memo, which hands it to the registered component as its `schema` prop through `React.createElement`;
- the metadata destructure;
- `resolveAriaProps` and `winningVisibilityKey`, both internal;
- the diagnostics, whose parameters are `unknown`.

No exported declaration names it: `SchemaRenderer` carries an explicit annotation, and `evaluateConfigBagInScope` returns `unknown`.

**Premise re-check** (`@object-ui/react` built at base `d0fba91aa` and again at `376e8d43b`, the last code commit; the only later commit is the `.changeset` file):

```
d.ts files: 70 (base) / 70 (after); sha256 of every one compared: DTS_DIFF_EXIT=0 (byte-identical)
dist hits InterpreterWorkingCopy: 0 files
dist hits DeclaredMembersOf: 0 files
dist hits InterpreterMarkers: 0 files
dist hits WorkingCopyAuthoredKeys: 0 files
control dist hits SchemaRendererProps: 2 files
```

The type is not exported, and the published surface did not move by a byte.

## H3: per-key verdicts

The rule is the seat's. If the spec declares the key on that node type, read it through the declared type. If it does not, retire the read, or report a fork when a real producer authors it.

| key | P1 reads | declared by | what the interpreter does | verdict | moves |
|---|--:|---|---|---|---|
| `properties` | 9 | spec `PageComponentSchema.properties` (a string-keyed `unknown` record); objectui's public-block arms through `propsBag` | evaluates per value, then hoists onto the node | declared; every read narrows with `isConfigBag`, as it already did. The bag is read as `main` has it (objectui#10859 rollout) | nothing |
| `props` | 6 | the maintainer's 2026-08-18 ruling (objectui#5123), quoted in `propsWithoutCanonicalKeys`' docblock | evaluates per value; the outgoing alias bag loses to `properties` | **bound**: named on the working type as the annotated legacy alias, `unknown`, narrowed by `isConfigBag`. ⛔ Not retired | nothing |
| `params` | 3 | spec `ActionButtonPropsSchema` / `ActionIconPropsSchema` `params`; objectui's action types | objectui#7867's params rule (carrier 1, node level) | declared; narrowed by `isParamsBag` | nothing |
| text keys (`title`, `value`, plus `label` / `description` from `BaseSchema`) | 3 | the spec's carriage map, `expressionBindableTextKeysFor` (objectstack#9599): per type, which keys are read back | evaluates a string value | declared by the map; read once into a local and narrowed by `typeof === 'string'` | nothing |
| `content` | 3 | spec `ElementTextPropsSchema.content`; objectui `TextSchema`, `MarkdownSchema`, `TooltipSchema` (string) and the container types (`SchemaNode`) | evaluates a string value | declared on many rows; narrowed by `typeof === 'string'`, as it already was | nothing |
| `visibility` | 3 | spec `PageComponentSchema.visibility`, `@deprecated` and "normalized to `visibleWhen` at parse" | the fourth SHOW leg of `shouldHide`; stripped before the props | declared by the spec: **typed on the working type by reference** (`PageComponent['visibility']`). Not narrowed: the leg is chosen by `!== undefined`, and `evaluateCondition` answers every runtime shape, so a narrowing guard would move the verdict for an off-spec value | nothing |
| `responsiveStyles` | 1 | spec `PageComponentSchema.responsiveStyles`; objectui `flex`, `object-grid` and `object-chart` (objectui#10872) | compiled to scoped CSS for every node (ADR-0065); stripped | declared; narrowed by `hasResponsiveStyles`. The now-redundant cast in `scopedStyling` is gone | nothing |
| `objectFields` | 1 | none: a host runtime prop by ruling (decision batch #70, objectui#7742) | the strip refuses an authored copy (objectui#8818) | host-supplied; the strip read is `unknown` and discarded | nothing |
| `schema` | 1 | none at node level: no node type declares it, and no renderer reads `schema.schema` | the strip protects the component's `schema` prop seat, which the interpreter fills with the node itself | host-supplied (the seat is the interpreter's); the strip read is `unknown` and discarded | nothing |
| `dataSource` | 1 | spec `PageComponentSchema.dataSource` | stripped (objectstack#5576) | read typed `unknown`; **the verdict is objectui#11070's**, left there | nothing |

No verdict retires a read, so no key needs a retirement census in this PR. No read's verdict needs a public node type to exist. The spec rows behind `content` (`element:text`) and `params` (`action:button` / `action:icon`) are public blocks, whose TS node types are objectui#11364's; the interpreter reads them generically and waits on nothing there.

### Producer census, for the keys whose verdict needed one

`git grep -nE` with the pattern: optional quote, then the key, then optional quote, `\s*:`, where the key is not preceded by a letter, `_` or `.`. Read at objectui `fd6f5da44` and objectstack `99398542b`, with test files excluded; the `*.zod.ts` files are excluded on the objectstack side. A dated reading: nothing re-derives it.

| key | ui examples | ui docs+skills | ui apps | ui packages src | os examples | os packages | os skills+docs | node-level producer |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|---|
| `visibleWhen` (positive control) | 5 | 12 | 4 | 56 | 15 | 171 | 17 | yes |
| `visibility` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 14 | 0 | 22 | 10 | **none**. Every hit was read: view-sharing, package and CLI `visibility`, prose, the interpreter's own strip, and the spec's `conversions/registry.ts` examples that rewrite it to `visibleWhen` |
| `responsiveStyles` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 34 | 13 | 7 | yes: the objectstack showcase and UI skill (as objectui#10872 recorded) |
| `objectFields` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 11 | 0 | 6 | 0 | **none**. Every objectui hit is a host injecting the React prop, and every objectstack hit is a lint-local variable |
| `_hidden` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **none**. The one hit is the interpreter's own strip |
| `_disabled` | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | **none**. Same strip; a repo-wide objectstack grep adds one unrelated test-local array |

For `schema`: zero renderers read `schema.schema` (positive control: `schema.properties`, 64 hits). The docs and catalog `"schema": {` hits are the nested `views[].schema` of `view-switcher` and a field's structured configuration, never a node key.

## H4: the markers

Confirmed from the code. `shouldHide` sets `_hidden = true`, and the enablement chain sets `_disabled = true`; nothing else writes either. `_hidden` is read once, by the render pass's early `return null`. `_disabled` is read once, by the metadata destructure, which strips both and re-emits `_disabled` as the element's `disabled` prop. No renderer reads either (`git grep` for a property access on either marker across `packages/` and `apps/`: only those sites and two test docblocks). No producer authors either (census above). Hence both are declared on the working type as interpreter-written.

## Tests: authoring literals typed as the nodes they are

Six suites passed fresh object literals straight to the `schema` prop. Each is now checked against the node it represents, through an identity helper (the objectui#11347 shape). That keeps every key checked after the removal, where a non-fresh variable would check nothing:
- `SchemaRenderer.aria.test.tsx`: the flat `ariaDescribedBy` / `role`, as Pick of the spec's `AriaProps`, plus `TestWidget`'s `content`;
- `SchemaRenderer.expressions.test.tsx`: `visibility`, as Pick of the spec's `PageComponent`;
- `SchemaRenderer.scopedStyleSchemaIdentity.test.tsx`: `responsiveStyles`, as Pick of `PageComponent`;
- `SchemaRenderer.errorBoundary.test.tsx` and `SchemaRenderer.unevaluatedExpressionDiagnostic.test.tsx`: each registered widget's own `content` / `value` / `title`;
- `SchemaNode.reconciliation.test.ts`: **fixture triage, a re-spelling**. `{ type: 'text', value: 'Hello' }` authored the spelling `TextSchema` retired for `content` (objectui#7016, `value?: never`). It is now `content: 'Hello'`, typed as `TextSchema`. Same string, same pin.

Two cross-file line citations in the touched test files are re-cited by content (AGENTS.md §5 #11), and one header that said the file no longer needs `BaseSchema` is corrected.

## Proofs (one-shot; nothing permanent left behind)

Both legs ran at `376e8d43b`, with the signature PRESENT, through `ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, and both are restored and proven (blob equal to HEAD `27b0fe283f31`, and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Predicted directions were written first.

- **Leg A, reverse validation.** A probe `const __probe11349: number = newSchema.undeclaredProbeKey11349;` is added after the copy. Predicted RED. Observed: `TSC_EXIT=2`, exactly 1 error, `error TS2322: Type 'unknown' is not assignable to type 'number'.` at the probe. An undeclared key reads as `unknown`, not `any`, while the signature still exists.
- **Leg B, ablation.** The same probe, with `DeclaredMembersOf` of `BaseSchema` replaced by bare `BaseSchema`. Predicted GREEN, because the signature's `any` absorbs the probe. Observed: `TSC_EXIT=0`, 0 errors. The mapped type is what carries leg A today.

## Gates, at `e22274398` unless stated

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/react^...' build`: exit 0 (at `d0fba91aa`; the diff touches no dependency of react).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, at `376e8d43b`, the last code commit.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/react/` from the repo root: `Test Files 106 passed (106)`, `Tests 1389 passed (1389)`, exit 0.
- `eslint .` in `packages/react` (the package's own `lint`), in JSON form: 176 files, **0 errors**, and all 7 touched files are in the population. The diff adds no `any` token outside comments and removes one typed `any` (the `resolveAriaProps` parameter).
- `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:published-dist`, `check:readme-exports`: all exit 0.
- `check:changeset-claims` names four pending paragraphs that cite `SchemaRenderer.tsx`. Each was re-read, and none is made false (runtime is unchanged).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. The changeset has an empty frontmatter: types only, nothing released.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 8 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.

Docs (AGENTS.md #2): no verdict moves a behaviour or an authoring surface. The docs that mention `BaseSchema`'s index signature or the predicate legs stay true, so this PR edits no doc.

## Acceptance notes (observations; nothing filed)

- **`visibility` has zero node-level producers**, and the spec normalizes it to `visibleWhen` at parse. So the renderer's leg serves raw, un-normalized metadata only. Retiring that read belongs to the spec's ADR-0089 deprecation and is not taken here. Carrier: none.
- **An authored `_hidden` / `_disabled` would arrive pre-set**, because the copy starts as `{ ...schema }`, and nothing refuses one. No producer writes either, and it was not measured through a public door. Carrier: none.
- **`resolveAriaProps`' flat `ariaDescribedBy` / `role`** are not `BaseSchema` members. The spec declares them only inside the nested `aria` bag (`AriaPropsSchema`), and objectui#4580 Q2-B keeps the flat reader. They are now typed `unknown` and forwarded as authored. Whether the authoring face declares them is objectui#8347's (and objectui#4580's) question.
- **`propsWithoutCanonicalKeys` still returns a string-keyed record of `any`** for the outgoing alias bag. That is not a read off the working copy, and it is left as it was. Carrier: none.

Out of scope here: `BaseSchema`, the removal, the compile-fail pin and AGENTS.md (objectui#8347); `ComponentRendererProps`; the public node types and the published `schema` prop type (objectui#11364); `dataSource`'s verdict (objectui#11070); the other packages' P1 sites (objectui#11347, objectui#11348).
